title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Android Build 280 (120 FPS Telegram-Style Smooth Swipe)
highlights: Butter-Smooth Telegram-Style Swipe: Zero-latency 1:1 finger tracking across bottom navigation tabs with PageScrollPhysics and persistent cached screen architecture.
Eliminated Layout Shifts: Synchronized app layout and header height across all bottom tabs for seamless horizontal transitions.
Persistent Red Form Field Validation: Mandatory fields (Customer Name, Mobile, Cart, Address, GSTIN) highlight in red until filled.
Isolated In-App Updater: Background downloader with progress bar and one-tap APK installation.
fixes: Equipped PageView with native PageScrollPhysics(parent: ClampingScrollPhysics()).
Cached bottom tab screen trees to eliminate re-instantiation and frame drops during horizontal drag.
Stabilized mobile dashboard top strip to eliminate layout jumps.
